info.description: What the nightly reset does, and what it leaves alone. This preview is meant to stay clean and presentable; the reset is how that happens.

enabled.description: Master switch. Off means the nightly job does nothing at all.

wipeContent.description: Delete and re-seed videos, images, articles and feed items.

wipeUserContent.description: Also delete comments, likes, playlists, subscriptions, chat rooms, chat messages and notifications. Off by default because it removes anything a visitor created, and this cannot tell a demo account's row from a real one.

resetAffinityGraphs.description: Reset every user's affinity graph to the default shape.

feedItems.description: The dynamic-zone feed items, as data rather than code. Leave empty to use the built-in defaults. The large fixtures (videos, images, articles) stay as files under cms/src/data — they are 100 to 155 KB each and belong in a repository, not in a form field.

lastRunSummary.description: What the last run actually did, so a failure is visible here rather than only in the logs.
